run.name: AdaptHealth Corp.
run.title: CP-OS host session (AHCO)
run.summary: AdaptHealth is a sizeable home-care provider with adequate liquidity and no debt maturity before 2029 beyond amortization, but earnings and free cash flow are weakening while debt rises, so the credit view is cautious. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Pre-recast: principal debt 1,750,000 thousand at 2025-12-31 over FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA 616,681 thousand, which includes Diabetes Health; net uses cash of 106,136 thousand. Not comparable with later rows.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Pre-recast Adjusted EBITDA 616,681 thousand over cash paid for interest 101,243 thousand; includes Diabetes Health.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 80,687 thousand. Undrawn: 2026 Revolver commitments of 450.0 million less 147.0 million drawn and 34.3 million of letters of credit (Q3 10-Q page:40, page:42). The delayed-draw term loan is fully drawn and adds nothing. 137.0 million was drawn at the filing date after a 10.0 million October repayment.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, the credit documents and a trailing leverage ratio on the current business are not available.
CP-1 main limitation: No full-year figure exists on the current business perimeter, so leverage on a trailing basis cannot be measured.
